title: Mitchell Starc scripts history, breaks all-time left-arm Test record
content: In a remarkable achievement, Mitchell Starc has etched his name in cricket history as the most successful left-arm bowler. He claimed his 434th Test wicket, overtaking Rangana Herath, while equaling Kapil Dev’s tally in fewer matches. Bangladesh's Hasan Mahmud proved a formidable challenge, snatching an impressive six wickets and leading his team to bowl Australia out for 198 runs.

title: Google co-founder’s a message for DeepMind staff after Demis Hassabis exits as CEO
content: Google co-founder Sergey Brin has been urging Google DeepMind staff to go all in on Gemini and catch up to the AI frontier, following a sweeping leadership overhaul that saw Demis Hassabis step aside as CEO. Koray Kavukcuoglu now runs day-to-day operations from Mountain View, with final say on major decisions. The reshuffle follows Gemini release delays, coding benchmark gaps against Anthropic and OpenAI, and high-profile exits including Jeff Dean.

title: Kolkata nurse found dead in hospital washroom during night shift
content: A 30-year-old nurse was discovered deceased at NRS Medical College and Hospital. She was on night duty when she went to the staff washroom. Colleagues found her unconscious after she did not return for some time. Preliminary investigation found no visible injury marks and no suicide note. The body has been sent for post-mortem examination.

title: 'Sorry for the pain': Australian cricketer breaks silence on cheating allegations
content: Australian cricket vice-captain Ashleigh Gardner has openly shared her emotions regarding the recent end of her relationship with Monica Wright. In her statement, she offered sincere apologies for the distress caused and confirmed that Cricket Australia fully supports her ongoing role. Gardner reflected with gratitude on their time together and conveyed her best wishes for Wright, requesting space for both of them to navigate this situation privately.

title: Months after Dells' $6.25bn ‘gift’, US Treasury sets new Trump Account paycheck rules
content: Under the new guidelines for Trump Accounts, both employers and employees can make contributions towards payrolls. Employers are permitted to add up to $2,500 annually without tax for dependent children, while employees can contribute pre-tax funds directly from their paychecks. In support of this initiative, Michael and Susan Dell committed $6.25 billion to boost child savings. The proposal is currently open for public feedback prior to its finalization.

title: 19-year-old Assam woman murdered in Noida PG, accused taken into custody
content: A 19-year-old woman from Assam was found dead in a locked room in Noida. Police suspect a man from the same building killed her after an argument. The victim arrived in Noida weeks before her death without informing her parents. Residents noticed a foul smell from the accused's locked room. Police have registered a murder case and are searching for the accused.

title: Michigan plans to remove century-old dam, restore 14 acres of wetlands
content: The historic removal of a dam in Michigan, over a century old, is set to rejuvenate the region's natural ecosystems. This collaborative project will facilitate the movement of aquatic life by clearing upstream habitats while addressing the environmental threats posed by polluted sediments. Restoration efforts will focus on enhancing wetlands and safeguarding vital cold water habitats downstream, fostering biodiversity and ecological balance.

title: College student rescues three drowning girls from Lake Washington
content: College student Lillie Vehling rescued three girls from Lake Washington during Seafair weekend.  She noticed the girls struggling beyond the buoy line and immediately entered the water.  Vehling, a former lifeguard and water polo player, brought the girls to safety one by one.  First responders arrived and provided medical assistance after the successful rescue.  Seafair honored Vehling as the "Lady Guardian of Lake Washington" for her bravery.

title: Mayor of League City in Texas says publican entities must not use H-1B
content: In a bold move, League City Mayor Nick Long expressed his disapproval of public agencies using the H-1B visa program. He believes that taxpayer-backed roles should be reserved for citizens and local alumni. This viewpoint was articulated following Texas State University's recent attempt to bring on an H-1B Public Relations Specialist.

title: Hurried cremation? Ex-TMC MLA Nirmal Ghosh arrested in RG Kar rape-murder case
content: Former Trinamool Congress MLA Nirmal Ghosh was arrested for his alleged role in a hurried cremation. This incident involved the body of a doctor raped and murdered at RG Kar Medical College. Ghosh and two others face charges for allegedly preventing evidence collection through hasty cremation. The new case is separate from the ongoing CBI investigation into the doctor's rape and murder.

title: E20 row: Carmakers data flags fuel contamination concerns; complaint later withdrawn
content: The rollout of E20 petrol has sparked dissatisfaction among motorists, with hundreds claiming the fuel has lowered vehicle mileage, increased wear and tear and even prompted at least one legal challenge.

title: 'Jadeja will punch me, but he is on the wrong side of thirty': Ex-India cricketer
content: Murali Kartik believes Manav Suthar possesses the skills to succeed Ravindra Jadeja. Suthar has shown promise with both bat and ball in recent matches. Jadeja is nearing the end of his distinguished Test cricket career. India is looking for future spin bowling options as Jadeja's time winds down. Suthar's emergence offers a promising prospect for the team's long-term strategy.

title: Watch: Surrendered women Maoists shine at Raipur fashion event
content: In the heart of Bastar, women who once wielded weapons are now strutting down fashion runways, showcasing a remarkable transformation. Recently, Chhattisgarh's Chief Minister engaged with a Union Minister in New Delhi, advocating for special provisions aimed at enhancing infrastructure projects in the region. After years of turmoil, Bastar has embraced peace, highlighting the urgent need for improved road connectivity and comprehensive development initiatives.

title: How Jude Bellingham’s family powered his rise to football stardom
content: Jude Bellingham’s football journey was shaped long before Real Madrid and England. His father Mark introduced him to the game through non-league football, while his mother Denise supported him through major moves and pressure. With brother Jobe also pursuing football, the Bellingham family made sacrifices, stayed close and helped Jude remain calm, humble and focused.

title: Dharmendra’s hand was 'like a shovel': Aamir Khan recalls first meeting the actor
content: Aamir Khan shared a heartwarming story from his early days on KBC, reminiscing about his first meeting with the iconic Dharmendra. He playfully remarked how Dharmendra's handshake felt akin to holding a shovel, highlighting the veteran actor's substantial build. This memorable interaction occurred when Aamir was assisting director Nasir Hussain, showcasing the unforgettable impact Dharmendra had on upcoming talents in Bollywood.

title: Japan's Hiroshima produces 60% of farmed oysters, but up to 90% have died
content: Hiroshima's oyster farmers face catastrophic losses this season, reporting mortality rates soaring to ninety percent, well above normal thresholds. Investigations are underway to pinpoint rising sea temperatures and environmental shifts as possible culprits. This alarming situation jeopardizes local dining establishments, tourism activities, and livelihoods. While government assistance provides temporary relief, the search for sustainable solutions continues.

title: Fresh clashes erupt along Assam-Arunachal border, police fire in air to disperse mob
content: Renewed clashes broke out along the Assam-Arunachal Pradesh border on Thursday, prompting police to fire warning shots to disperse a growing mob. This turmoil ensues after eighteen Assamese villagers were reportedly injured in Monday's confrontation, which revolved around accusations of land encroachment. Officials are now working diligently to ease tensions and restore peace in the region.

title: Hardik Pandya's Gujarat Titans trade collapses over captaincy demand
content: Hardik Pandya's anticipated transfer from Mumbai Indians has hit a snag as negotiations with Gujarat Titans failed due to differing views on his captaincy expectations. Having previously secured a title with Gujarat, Pandya's prospects remain in limbo after a lackluster season with Mumbai. Currently, he's prioritizing his fitness ahead of India's upcoming series against Afghanistan.

title: Mystery surrounds couple found dead in Mysuru, Ernakulam
content: In a shocking turn of events, an engaged couple due to marry on December twenty-sixth was found deceased on Wednesday. P Anusree was discovered lifeless in her rented home in Mysuru, Karnataka, and her fiancé, Amal, was tragically found hanging in a nearby hotel in Ernakulam. Prior to her death, a video call was made between the couple, leaving unanswered questions in the wake of their untimely demise.

title: Video: Rape-convict ex-MP Prajwal Revanna seen using phone inside Bengaluru jail
content: A video shows Prajwal Revanna using a mobile phone inside his prison cell. This incident follows a raid which recovered a 5G smartphone and other items. Officials found WhatsApp and Netflix on the password-protected device. A prison official was suspended for alleged dereliction of duty. Revanna is serving a life sentence after a rape case conviction.

title: Video: Pitbull mauls Patiala couple viewing rental home, woman suffers deep wounds
content: A couple sustained severe injuries after a pitbull attacked them while inspecting a house.  The dog mauled the wife's arm and other body parts, requiring surgery.  Her husband also suffered deep bite wounds while trying to rescue her from the animal.  CCTV footage shows residents attempting to fend off the aggressive dog with sticks.  This incident has prompted discussions about banning aggressive dog breeds in the city.

title: Bengaluru mom’s death sparks fury, civic body faces heat over poor roads
content: Residents held a candlelight march protesting civic negligence. They blamed the Chandapura municipal council for a fatal accident. Medha Akarsh, a central government employee, died after falling from a two-wheeler. Protesters demanded accountability from civic authorities for the preventable tragedy. The municipal council promised an urgent meeting with officials and contractors.

title: Months after ‘suicide’ video, Gujarat man kills estranged wife in US
content: A 32-year-old Gujarati man faces a murder charge in Chicago after his wife's death.  Police discovered the woman unresponsive with a stab wound to her neck.  The accused was apprehended at O'Hare International Airport nine hours later.  Family members allege the woman had left her husband twice before this incident.  The couple had relocated to the United States eight years ago from Michigan.

title: ‘Respect decision’: Tata Trusts reacts to N Chandrasekaran’s exit move

title: Beyond the Hawk: How IAF's 150 new trainers will prepare pilots for next-gen air combat
content: The Indian Air Force is initiating the acquisition of 150 advanced jet trainers. These new aircraft will replace the existing British Aerospace Hawk Mk-132 fleet. The air force seeks information from global manufacturers for these Stage-III trainers. This procurement aims to enhance pilot training for future fighter aircraft. The new trainers are expected to enter service in the 2030s.

title: Jana Nayagan box office collection day 22 [Live]: Vijay starrer nears Rs 195 cr
content: Jana Nayagan continues its successful run in theatres, now in its fourth week. The film has garnered an impressive domestic net collection of Rs 194.46 crore, with a gross collection in India soaring to Rs 226.50 crore. Currently, it's being showcased in 523 theaters across the country, attracting a steady occupancy rate of approximately 10.5% on its twenty-second day.

title: Salman Khan unveils ‘7 dogs’ trailer as Sanjay Dutt joins international cast

Directed by Adil El Arbi and Bilall Fallah, audiences can expect breathtaking action sequences on a grand scale.

title: How the first bird learned to fly 150 million years ago, study reveals
content: A new August 2026 study may have solved the long-standing mystery of how the first birds took flight. Researchers from the University of Southampton and Paris’s National Natural History Museum used 3D models and billions of simulations to study Archaeopteryx, which lived around 150 million years ago. Their findings suggest it could not launch like modern birds, but instead used rapid two-legged jumps, relying heavily on its legs before transitioning to sustained wing-assisted flight.

title: New York’s pied-à-terre tax explained: Which luxury homes could face an extra bill?
content: New York City's new tax targets expensive second homes not used as primary residences.  This measure aims to generate significant annual revenue for the city.  However, complex ownership structures complicate tax liability determination for many owners.  The city has sent notices to thousands of properties, offering exemption opportunities.  Homeowners are challenging the tax's implementation and fairness in court proceedings.
